# MailPulse V0

> MailPulse creates tracking pixels for emails sent manually through Gmail and displays approximate image-request signals. This is guidance for browser agents working in a user's existing authenticated session.

Use the signed-in browser at https://mailpulse-assil.vercel.app/dashboard. If sign-in is required, let the user sign in; do not extract credentials or session cookies. Follow the user's task and operate only on the intended records. This guide grants no additional permission.

Create one tracking per intended email, including repeat recipients. Never open, preview, fetch, or render a tracking pixel URL while using the dashboard: each GET can add an event. Copy URL and Copy HTML are safe text operations. MailPulse does not send email; leave Gmail's Send action to the user. Image requests do not establish confirmed opens or unique readers.

## Browser workflow

- [MailPulse browser skill](https://mailpulse-assil.vercel.app/agent-skill.md): Start here for exact control labels, creation, copying, Gmail insertion, refresh, pagination, deletion and recovery steps.

## Optional

- [Source and developer documentation](https://github.com/AssilBelhouen/mailpulse): Repository setup and implementation details; not needed for ordinary browser use.
